```
-- Audit trail of database deployments. Every post-deployment run must append
-- exactly one row describing what was applied.
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[DeploymentHistory]
(
    [DeploymentId]  INT             IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    [ScriptName]    NVARCHAR (200)  NOT NULL,
    [AppliedAt]     DATETIME2 (3)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_DeploymentHistory_AppliedAt] DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
    [AppliedBy]     NVARCHAR (128)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT [DF_DeploymentHistory_AppliedBy] DEFAULT (SUSER_SNAME()),
    [Notes]         NVARCHAR (1000) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_DeploymentHistory] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([DeploymentId] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [UQ_DeploymentHistory_ScriptName] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ([ScriptName] ASC)
);
```

```
/*
Post-deployment script
----------------------
Runs AFTER the schema diff is applied.

Responsibilities:
  1. Seed / refresh reference (dimension) data.
  2. Run data migrations for this release.
  3. Append one row to [dbo].[DeploymentHistory].

Keep every statement idempotent - this script runs on every publish.
*/
PRINT N'[PostDeployment] start';
GO

:r .\Seed\DimProduct.sql
GO

:r .\Seed\DimStore.sql
GO

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Deployment audit
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[DeploymentHistory] WHERE [ScriptName] = N'baseline')
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[DeploymentHistory] ([ScriptName], [Notes])
    VALUES (N'baseline', N'Initial RetailDW schema: dimensions, temporal FactSales, staging, ETL.');
END
GO

PRINT N'[PostDeployment] end';
GO
```

_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-5)**_

`dbo.DeploymentHistory` (`RetailDW/Tables/dbo.DeploymentHistory.sql`) is an audit trail of database deployments, not of data loads.

**Columns:**
- `DeploymentId` — identity PK
- `ScriptName` — name of the deployment/migration script (unique — prevents re-applying the same script twice)
- `AppliedAt` — UTC timestamp, defaults to `SYSUTCDATETIME()`
- `AppliedBy` — defaults to `SUSER_SNAME()` (who ran it)
- `Notes` — free-text description of what the script did

**How it's used:** `RetailDW/Scripts/PostDeployment.sql#L24-L29` inserts one row per release, guarded by an `IF NOT EXISTS` check on `ScriptName`, e.g. the `'baseline'` row describing the initial schema. This lets you answer "which migration scripts have been applied to this database, when, and by whom" — useful for tracking schema version history and avoiding duplicate/destructive re-runs.

Per `.github/instructions/sql-conventions.instruction.md#L16`, the convention is: every deployment that backfills or migrates existing data must append exactly one row here.

This is distinct from `dbo.LoadLog`, which tracks ETL/data-load runs rather than schema deployments.
